title: Lean model calls pay for ~8k tokens of auto-memory when run from the repo folder

owner_note.text: Measured: a no-tools Haiku call from the repo costs $0.066 because the project's auto-memory is loaded; from a temp folder it costs $0.002. RefineCall now takes a `cwd` and the refine queue uses it; Echo and other RefineCall users still run from the repo and would get the same saving from a one-word change.
